english.note: Use this colloquial choice when the emphasis is on trying to reach or get hold of someone.

exampleSentences.english: Contact me if anything comes up.
exampleSentences.jyutping: jau5 me1 si6 zau6 wan2 ngo5 laa1

english.note: Use 搵 when “reach” means trying to contact or get hold of someone, especially by phone or message.

exampleSentences.english: I still can't reach him after calling several times.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我打咗幾次電話都搵唔到佢。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 daa2 zo2 gei2 ci3 din6 waa2 dou1 wan2 m4 dou2 keoi5
